title.en: Ember-1 Cuts Reasoning Tokens Without Losing Quality

excerpt.zh: Ember-1是Fireworks基于Kimi K3训练的专用模型，官方称其在保持相近效果的同时减少约40%令牌，但独立验证仍待观察。
excerpt.en: Ember-1 is Fireworks’ Kimi K3-based model, claiming similar quality with about 40% fewer tokens; independent validation remains open.

disclosure.zh: 本文使用星期天AI中转站大模型，基于 Hacker News 内容自动生成。
disclosure.en: This article was automatically generated by the Weekly Day AI gateway model using content from Hacker News.

text.zh: Ember-1是Fireworks Research推出的专用模型，基于Kimi K3训练。Fireworks称，它学习保留有用的反思和规划，同时压缩冗余推理，在相近回答质量下平均减少约40%的令牌；这对多轮编码代理尤其重要，因为早期推理内容会在后续调用中反复进入上下文并产生费用。
text.en: Ember-1 is a specialized model from Fireworks Research, trained from Kimi K3. Fireworks says it learned to preserve useful reflection and planning while removing redundant reasoning, cutting tokens by about 40% at comparable answer quality. This matters particularly for multi-turn coding agents, where earlier reasoning is repeatedly included in later calls and billed again.

text.zh: 官方介绍称，团队进行了50多次训练实验和200多次评估，并覆盖数学、编码、工具使用、搜索与软件工程等任务。其公开测试中，Ember-1在多个行业基准上接近或达到Kimi K3最高推理设置的质量，同时成本更低；在SWE-bench Verified上，Ember-1得分为92.2%，K3最高设置为93.2%。
text.en: The company says the team ran more than 50 training experiments and over 200 evaluations across mathematics, coding, tool use, search, and software engineering. In its published tests, Ember-1 generally approached or matched Kimi K3 at its highest reasoning setting while costing less. On SWE-bench Verified, Ember-1 scored 92.2%, compared with 93.2% for K3 at maximum effort.

text.zh: Fireworks还报告了两家客户生产编码流量的A/B测试：每项任务的令牌数约减少35%，而任务完成、成功分数和失败率等下游指标大体持平或改善。公司内部开发者也据称没有明显察觉模型切换。不过，这些结果主要来自Fireworks自己的评估和有限的客户测试，不能直接等同于所有工作负载都能获得相同收益。
text.en: Fireworks also reports A/B tests on production coding traffic from two customers. Tokens fell by roughly 35% per task while downstream measures such as completion, success scores, and failure rates generally held steady or improved. The company says its own developers did not notice the switch. Still, these findings come mainly from Fireworks’ evaluations and a small number of customer tests, so they do not establish the same savings for every workload.

text.zh: 研究预览带来的开放问题
text.en: The Open Questions Behind the Research Preview

text.zh: Ember-1目前以Serverless研究预览形式与基础版Kimi K3并列提供，后续是否长期保留取决于社区需求。它的核心价值不是简单调低推理强度，而是让模型学会更有效地思考；但更短的推理轨迹是否会在长链代理、罕见错误和不同领域任务中稳定保持质量，仍需要更广泛的独立测试。
text.en: Ember-1 is currently offered alongside the base Kimi K3 as a Serverless Research Preview, with longer-term availability tied to community demand. Its central promise is not merely lowering a reasoning setting, but teaching the model to reason more efficiently. Whether shorter traces reliably preserve quality in long agentic workflows, rare failure cases, and unfamiliar domains still requires broader independent testing.
